item.text:
The refund is the price of the returned items with the order’s discount applied, **rounded half up to the nearest cent**. [Refund rule](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/docs/behavior/returns/submit-return.md:11)

For example, returning a map priced at 8.50 from an order with 33% off:

**8.50 × 0.67 = 5.695 → refund of 5.70.**
